C-CRITERION-CLOSE-EVIDENCE.Summary: Add a close-bound acceptance-criterion state so a criterion whose evidence exists only at the close is authorable, distinguishable from a forgotten mapping, and evaluated by a shipped check at the first point where that evidence exists and a verdict can still be recorded. Post-archive lint 0/0 is the motivating case, expressed as CloseEvidence whose Command exits non-zero on warnings, not as an AC-* this bundle itself authors.
C-CRITERION-CLOSE-EVIDENCE.Problem:
HEAD 892c711 on main, packaged 6.2.0, tree clean, active empty before this bundle, lint 0/0, archive 46. Those numbers are a snapshot.
An AC-* is either mapped (a task Satisfies child names it) or unmapped. There is no third state. collectAcceptanceCriteriaIds and collectSatisfiedAcceptanceCriteria (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1951-1978) know those two sets only. validateSpecPlanCoverage (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1876-1892) emits change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped at warning when an AC-* is in the first set and not the second. Satisfies allows only AC-* children or None (src/artifact/grammar.ts:2056-2068). Verdict records outcome, optional scope, classification, and constituentTasksPassed (src/artifact/grammar.ts:776-848); they do not bind an AC-*. Semantic anchors are attribute-free tags (artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute).
AC-SUITE-AND-LINT in the copied model-plan shape claimed 0 errors and 0 warnings after apply and archive, and was Satisfies-linked to a task that ends before that close (F82). Authoring the close half as an unmapped AC-* emits the unmapped warning, so a 0/0 bar fails on a warning about itself (F83 related paragraph; F83.1). That trap is why C-CURSOR-TASK-SENTINEL was superseded. C-DRIFT-HONESTY archived the workaround: task-observable AC-SUITE-AND-CI, post-archive lint 0/0 as close-verdict evidence, no AC-SUITE-AND-LINT element. The teaching template ships AC-SKELETON, not AC-SUITE-AND-LINT (skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/references/change-spec-template.xml:14). The force is habit, not the template.
Default lint fail-on is errors (src/grace-lint.ts:79, :184). Exit 0 is not 0 errors and 0 warnings. The 0/0 bar is the printed counts, or lint with argv token fail-on set to warnings.
Close sequence (D20): argv token assertions final, review, gate verdict, gate apply, gate archive, applied status writes, archive move. Post-archive lint is authority practice after the move, not a CLI verb. Run-ledgers end at the archive Decision (F86). resolveChangeBundle searches active then archive (src/grace-cursor.ts:500-502), so gate verdict can already write a Verdict into an applied archived ledger. Nothing requires that write, and nothing evaluates a criterion there.
Coverage runs on archive as well as active (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1298-1307) and skips only superseded (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1822-1824). This repo's applied archives have no unmapped AC-* (root lint 0/0). plan new Satisfies-links every AC-* from the spec to T-001 (src/artifact/skeletons.ts:171-173).

Goals.Goal: Make a close-bound AC-* authorable as a CloseEvidence child of that AC-*, not as an attribute on the anchor, not as a Satisfies target, and not as a new AcceptanceCriteria sibling section.
Keep a forgotten AC-* (no Satisfies, no CloseEvidence) emitting change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped at warning, same code, same severity, same message family.

Evaluate each CloseEvidence Command at gate verdict when the bundle is applied and lives under archive/. Refuse to record outcome pass if any named Command exits non-zero. Record each AC-* result as Verdict children in that same write (D16).

Have ngrace review on an applied archived bundle raise a catalogued finding when a CloseEvidence AC-* has no recorded evaluation. Review findings are not lint issues, so a 0/0 lint bar cannot fail on a warning about itself.
Stop plan new from Satisfies-linking a CloseEvidence AC-* to T-001.

README.md is in scope only for the skillTextLines total / totalBytes measurement cell (README.md:299) if this deliverable rewrites a SKILL.md. examples/ is unchanged; no user-visible surface. Silence would fail checkDocsAndExamplesDecision.

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T2 (cross-cutting). Grammar, lint catalog, gate verdict writer, review detector, skeleton emission, and skill text. Tiers never skip argv token assertions final.

Distinguishability. Close-bound is an AC-* that has a CloseEvidence child containing at least one non-empty Command. Forgotten is an AC-* that has neither CloseEvidence nor a Satisfies reference. An empty CloseEvidence, a CloseEvidence with no Command, or a CloseEvidence whose only child is a decoration tag, is change.close-evidence-incomplete at error, not an unmapped exemption. Typing a marker is not the third state.

An AC-* must not be both close-bound and task-mapped. Satisfies of a CloseEvidence AC-* is change.close-evidence-and-satisfied at error. That is F82 enforced: close evidence must not be claimed by a task pass.

The evaluator is gate verdict (src/gates/command.ts record path; src/gates/ledger.ts:248 recordReviewVerdict) when resolveChangeBundle returns an archive/ path and spec status is applied. It runs each CloseEvidence Command and records the result on that Verdict. It does not run CloseEvidence on an active bundle: that write is the apply-gate verdict and the evidence does not exist yet. No new argv token. Grammar expresses the state; the existing verdict verb evaluates it.

Pass is process exit 0 of the named Command. A 0/0 lint bar is a Command that exits non-zero when warnings exist: lint with argv token fail-on set to warnings. This bundle does not add a lint-output parser. Default fail-on stays errors.

Lint does not emit a diagnostic that a CloseEvidence AC-* has not yet been evaluated. That diagnostic on the 0/0 Command would recreate F83.1. Authoring codes (incomplete, both-states, invalid child) stay lint errors because they are shape, not close-time evidence.

Superseded and cancelled bundles never reach an applied close. CloseEvidence on those statuses is inert: no evaluation required, no review absence finding. Forgotten AC-* on cancelled still warn as they do today. Superseded coverage stays skipped (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1822-1824). Rejected follows cancelled.

Existing archives must stay 0 errors. CloseEvidence is additive; no applied archive in this repo authors it. A check that would warn on those 46 bundles is not shippable without an explicit grandfather recorded here. This spec records none because none is needed if the checks are additive.

change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped stays warning. Raising it to error would turn in-progress mapping (spec and plan both exist, some AC-* not yet Satisfies linked) into an invalid artifact, and would be a D5.2 break for any adopter who treats the warning as a TODO. Once CloseEvidence exists, the 0/0 self-trap is gone without that raise.

This spec does not author AC-SUITE-AND-LINT and must not Satisfies-link lint-after-archive to any task. Until this bundle ships, the trap it repairs still applies to it. Split: AC-SUITE-AND-CI is task-observable; post-archive lint 0/0 is close-verdict evidence quoted in the verdict (D16), not an AC-*. C-DRIFT-HONESTY construction (archive/C-DRIFT-HONESTY/spec.xml:1254-1317).

F56 / F67: FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET is 4, so a task may plan at most three distinct fail signatures. FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET is 2 under exact kind-plus-key equality. F80: one red evidences one property. F45: do not manufacture a red for a HEAD-true property. AC-PIN-REMEASURE is a bounding pin (F84), not a manufactured red. AC-FORGOTTEN-UNCHANGED, AC-NO-NEW-ARGV, and AC-ARCHIVE-COMPAT have HEAD-true halves; redden only the new exemption, the new evaluator, and the new detector.

F61: no two adjacent hyphens inside any XML comment body. Name argv tokens. F66: README.md and examples/ are decided in Goals and NonGoals above and below. Do not edit docs/plans/**, the phase board, CHANGELOG.md, any version surface, or .ngrace/changes/archive/**. Packaged version at authoring: 6.2.0. No product version bump.

NonGoals.NonGoal: A new CLI argv token, a new gate subcommand, or a lifecycle finish verb. P3.1 / D1 owns lifecycle finish. C-ARCHIVE-CURSOR owns archive-gate cursor predicates. If a later measurement shows gate verdict on applied archive is the wrong home, re-spec; do not add argv here.
Raising change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped to error. Argument is in Constraints.
An attribute on AC-* (when, phase, bind). Semantic anchors are attribute-free. F38 already recorded what happens when an anchor is stuffed into an attribute.
A Satisfies target that is the close, a verdict, or a non-AC-* child. Satisfies is task to AC-*. Close-bound is declared on the criterion.
Evaluating CloseEvidence at argv token assertions final, at review before apply, or at gate archive. Those run before the archive move. Post-archive evidence does not exist there.
Mutating existing archives, rewriting C-DRIFT-HONESTY, or making post-archive lint 0/0 an AC-* on this bundle's own spec.
D19 / D20 skill text, ngrace-execute close-ownership sentences, approval fingerprints (C-APPROVAL-FINGERPRINT), co-draft (C-CO-DRAFT), or supersede verb (C-SUPERSEDE-VERB).
examples/ unchanged; no user-visible surface. Owner: unchanged; no user-visible surface.
README.md except the skillTextLines measurement cell named in Goals, and only if a SKILL.md rewrite moves the published figures.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-THIRD-STATE-DISTINCT: An AC-* with a CloseEvidence child that contains at least one non-empty Command is close-bound. collectAcceptanceCriteriaIds still lists it. collectSatisfiedAcceptanceCriteria does not, unless a task illegally Satisfies it. validateSpecPlanCoverage does not emit change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped for that id. Empty CloseEvidence, CloseEvidence with no Command, or CloseEvidence whose children are not Command, is change.close-evidence-incomplete at error. CloseEvidence is a child element, never an attribute on the AC-* tag. HEAD today: no CloseEvidence element exists; any AC-* without Satisfies warns. Failure conditions: an attribute is the only mark; an empty marker exempts unmapped; a forgotten AC-* becomes silent.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FORGOTTEN-UNCHANGED: Stay-true plus exemption isolation. An AC-* with no CloseEvidence and no Satisfies still emits change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped at warning, same code, from src/artifact/grammar.ts:1883-1890. Legacy free-text AcceptanceCriteria without AC-* still skips mapping. HEAD today: that warning already fires. Do not manufacture a red for the forgotten path (F45). Redden the exemption: a CloseEvidence AC-* must not emit that warning. Failure conditions: forgotten goes silent; forgotten becomes error; CloseEvidence still warns unmapped.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NOT-BOTH: A task Satisfies child naming a CloseEvidence AC-* emits change.close-evidence-and-satisfied at error on the plan. Unknown Satisfies targets stay change.unknown-acceptance-criterion at error. HEAD today: Satisfies of a defined AC-* is legal. Failure conditions: both states are legal; the new error swallows unknown-target.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-EVALUATED-AT-CLOSE: When gate verdict runs against a bundle whose path is under archive/ and whose spec status is applied, it runs each CloseEvidence Command and records one child per such AC-* on that Verdict (id, exit, pass or fail). It refuses to record outcome pass if any Command exits non-zero. When gate verdict runs against an active bundle, it does not run CloseEvidence. No new argv token is registered on gate, lint, or review. HEAD today: recordReviewVerdict writes an empty-children Verdict (src/gates/ledger.ts:319-324) and never runs a Command. Failure conditions: evaluation on active; pass recorded after a failed Command; results only in the note prose; a new argv token.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REVIEW-DETECTS-ABSENCE: ngrace review with argv token change on an applied archived bundle emits a catalogued review.* finding when a CloseEvidence AC-* has no recorded evaluation on any Verdict. The same review on an active, superseded, cancelled, or rejected bundle does not emit that finding. The finding is not a lint change.* code. HEAD today: review has no CloseEvidence reader. Failure conditions: lint emits the absence; review emits it before apply; review is the only evaluator and gate verdict never runs the Command (F89 decoration).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-TERMINAL-INERT: A superseded, cancelled, or rejected archive that declares CloseEvidence does not require a recorded evaluation and does not emit the review absence finding. Forgotten AC-* on cancelled or rejected still warn. change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped stays skipped for superseded. HEAD today: superseded skips coverage; cancelled does not. Failure conditions: cancelled CloseEvidence required to have a close verdict; superseded CloseEvidence errors.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-COMPAT: After this lands, bun run ngrace lint with argv token path set to this repository root against the existing 46 archives adds no new error and no new warning on those bundles. Additive shape only. HEAD today: those archives are 0/0. Do not manufacture a red against them (F45). Failure conditions: an existing archive warns or errors; a grandfather that hides a real new defect on a new CloseEvidence.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SKELETON-EXCLUDES: ngrace plan new writes Satisfies only for spec AC-* that are not close-bound. A spec that has one CloseEvidence AC-* and one ordinary AC-* yields a skeleton that Satisfies-links only the ordinary one. HEAD today: every AC-* is linked (src/artifact/skeletons.ts:171-173). Failure conditions: CloseEvidence AC-* still auto-Satisfies; ordinary AC-* stop being linked.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-NEW-ARGV: Stay-true. src/grace.ts command registration and gate / lint / review arg maps gain no new token. CloseEvidence is grammar. Evaluation is the existing gate verdict verb. HEAD today: no close-evidence argv exists. Do not manufacture a red (F45). Failure conditions: a new token is the only way the state is expressed.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PIN-REMEASURE: Task-observable bounding pin (F84); a later plan Satisfies-links this to the task that rewrites any SKILL.md. After that rewrite, src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts pins and the README.md:299 measurement cell both match a fresh skillTextLines() measure (totalBytes, and total if the rewrite moves the line count). One re-measurement updates every place the figure is published. Do not manufacture a red for the pin at HEAD (F45). HEAD today: total 806, totalBytes 55486, in both the test pin and the README cell.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-CI: Task-observable; a later plan Satisfies-links this. bun test green for touched packages (grammar, catalog, skeletons, gates, review, skill-contracts, token-accounting, and any other test this deliverable forces). bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts exits 0. A task that Satisfies this criterion must put those commands in its Verification block. This criterion does not include lint. HEAD today: those commands are green; that green is the baseline, not this change's evidence.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red-first on AC-THIRD-STATE-DISTINCT, AC-NOT-BOTH, AC-EVALUATED-AT-CLOSE, AC-REVIEW-DETECTS-ABSENCE, AC-SKELETON-EXCLUDES, and the exemption half of AC-FORGOTTEN-UNCHANGED, each property its own red (F80), split across tasks so no task plans more than three distinct signatures or repeats a signatureKey (F56, F67). AC-FORGOTTEN-UNCHANGED forgotten path, AC-NO-NEW-ARGV, and AC-ARCHIVE-COMPAT are HEAD-true stay-true halves, not reds (F45). AC-TERMINAL-INERT is a characterization of statuses that never close; redden only if a new required evaluation fires on them. AC-PIN-REMEASURE is a bounding pin (F84), not a red. AC-SUITE-AND-CI is task-observable suite evidence. Post-archive lint 0/0 is close-verdict evidence (F82), quoted in the close verdict after apply and archive, not claimed by a task pass, and is not an AC-*.

Assumptions.Assumption: resolveChangeBundle will keep searching archive/ after active/ (src/grace-cursor.ts:500-502). If that walk is later restricted to active/, gate verdict cannot record close evidence and this design is blocked.
Verdict children are currently empty (src/gates/ledger.ts:319-324). Adding per-AC result children is an additive ledger shape. Existing Verdicts without those children stay valid.
Root lint fail-on stays errors. 0/0 as quoted counts remains authority practice for this bundle's own close, not an AC-*.
